new_people.concrete_exclusions: READY TO CREATE — The inspected OPR transcript records birth 5 June 1769 and baptism 18 June 1769 at Midcalder, father Alexr Glasgow and mother Emilia Glending. Two companion indexes give Alexander and Emilia Glendining for the same baptism. Existing Abigail Glasgow-1655 is excluded by her recorded 1759 marriage in Ireland, ten years before this birth. All accessible historical exact-name and spelling-variant results were checked on 22 October 2026; no compatible historical profile or existing draft was retained. The parents’ modern profile identities remain unresolved; no parent attachment is proposed. Three indexes represent one event, not independent corroboration.

READY TO CREATE — Both inspected indexes explicitly report birth year 1786 at Glasgow; one records baptism 7 April 1786. No parents are supplied. The compatible pair is consolidated rather than split. Glasgow-1227 was already married in 1741; Glasgow-1235 was born before his 1745 baptism; Glasgow-750 belongs to a nineteenth-century Pennsylvania/Civil War household and was born after this baptism. These concrete chronological conflicts exclude the returned historical candidates on the indexed birth-year reading. Exact Abraham and Abram searches returned the same three profiles; local drafts contain no additional person. The original register must test the indexed birth year and whether baptism was adult; do not invent parents or a precise birth date.
